title: Why America Finally Killed The Penny
hook: The US was losing money on every penny and nickel it made.
closing: The penny's long run ends because minting pocket change stopped making financial sense.
question: Would you miss the penny?

segments.say: Making pennies cost taxpayers 86 million dollars a year, more than the coin was worth.
That decision ends the penny's 232-year run, far longer than any other coin the US ever dropped.
The nickel is even worse: it costs 13.78 cents to make a coin worth five.
